title: Purple Skull Demon Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a horned skeletal demon character with white skull mask, purple and white ornate armor, and flowing purple energy effects. The sequence shows the figure channeling swirling purple flames, striking dynamic martial arts stances, and releasing a powerful purple energy explosion from the ground.
prompt: A four-panel sequence of a fierce horned skeletal demon warrior with a white skull mask, curved horns, purple and white traditional fantasy armor with skull motifs, and flowing purple ribbons. The character is shown in dynamic martial arts poses: summoning swirling purple fire around his arms, executing a fighting stance, exploding with a violent purple energy burst from the ground, and landing in a powerful ready position, all against a plain gray background.
